citation: Amir, Leaf and Stylios (2020), A Model of Seam Pucker and Its Applications. Part II: Experimental, Table1, DOI10.1080/00405000.2019.1646076

candidate.limitation: Low-stiffness engineering approximation based on a thinner measured thread; not a calibration of the0.8mm collision strand.
candidate.equation: k_i=B / ((L_i+L_previous)/2); passive straight-rest torques use native D6 rotY/rotZ force drives, gains per degree = gains per radian*pi/180. Axial twist free; no angular limits.
candidate.damping: c_i=2*zeta*sqrt(k_i*I_reduced), using cylinder transverse inertia only for this damping estimate. Native capsule inertia remains unchanged.

energy_note: Read-only centreline bending energy is a small-angle proxy; it is not asserted identical to PhysX finite-angle D6 potential and does not decide a pass.
native_drive_note: Same rotY/rotZ gains as recommended for D6 swing; per-degree authored gains compensate the parser conversion to radians. A SphericalJoint alone has no supported drive, so the optional candidate uses generic D6 translation locks.
